notes: Index of the Afrod JSON recipes the shaping engine offers per feature (blender/SHAPING-PLAN.md, 'Terrain editor -> Blender'). 'file' is relative to $GOLFMAP_AFROD_RECIPES (default D:/gspro/afrod-recipes; third-party files stay there untouched), then blender/recipes/ (ours).

'paint' says what each colour a recipe leaves means, as a golfmap role, separately for the bunker/water mesh ('mesh') and its blend strip ('blend'). After the recipe, blender/tools/shape_paint.py (remap_after_recipe) rewrites the touched objects' paint so every channel carries its canonical role (the golfmap convention in blender/conventions/bunker-channels.json). A missing colour keeps its channel; an empty map means the recipe does not repaint that part, so OPCD's paint is still there and 'opcdDefault' applies.

Rings: Afrod counts rings in from an object's open boundary. On a joined bunker + blend (meshblendjoin / meshblendjoinpermanent) ring 0 is the blend's OUTER edge (OPCD blends are one quad strip: ring 0 outer, ring 1 the seam), so 'red on rings 0-2 of the joined mesh' is the blend plus the bunker's rim. After meshblendseparate only the bunker mesh is selected, so later paint steps touch the mesh alone.

'join': 'last-blend' = meshblendjoin (Afrod joins the alphanumerically last blend of the mesh, same opcd_parent_id; any other split blends keep OPCD's paint), 'permanent' = meshblendjoinpermanent (every blend is merged into the mesh for good and loses its material: no blend objects remain), 'none' = the recipe works on the mesh only.
'default': the recipe a feature of that surface gets when the course names none (one per surface).
kaustin's 'Bunker overhang' download (kaustin-Bunker overhang-20260928T173517Z-1-001) is an empty folder: no recipe to index.

grassLip.text: grass lip: the adjoining grass look, 3D grass grows

shadow.text: dark lip without 3D grass (rolled-lip shadow line) / dark wet edge

floor.text: sand / water bed (no wet-sand channel: wet paint becomes sand)

browning.text: browning grass / dirt toward the hazard

opcdDefault.notes: OPCD's own paint, for objects no painting recipe touched (and the parts of a recipe's objects it leaves alone). Read off vreta_svg_1985 and the OPCD 'Theme - Default' materials: bunker mesh rings red, green, green, then blue; bunker material red/green = dirt (array index 4), blue/black = sand (6); bunker blend red at the bunker (= the bunker's red, dirt), black at the rough (= the rough's red). Lake mesh the same rings; Water Base Lake material red = grass (2), green/blue = soil (4) - already the golfmap layout. Lake blends: red at the water (lake grass), black at the deep rough (grass): both become 'adjoining', so no blend channel OPCD leaves unset (green/blue, base index 0) is used before Unity has a water convention. Creeks differ: Water Base Creek red/green/blue = soil (4), black = grass (2), and Vreta's narrow creek meshes are red all over (soil) -> dirt; creek blends are like bunker blends (red = the creek's soil at the water, black = deep rough).

studioPaint.notes: What a studio step's output paint means, as golfmap roles (golfmap recipes remap it right after the step; an entry's stepPaint or a step's own paint wins). Bunker Studio (bunker_studio/__init__.py _deform_bunker / _rebuild_blend): bunker mesh (red, 0, 1 - red) = red dirt fading to blue sand; blend (red, 0, 0) = red the dirt fade at the bunker, black the grass outside; blend UV0 = its 3D-grass density (kept as is). Shoreline Studio (shoreline_studio/core.py surface_zone_color): every preset paints its zone stops red (rim, 0) -> green (bank) -> blue (bed) -> black (deepest) across the water base, in preset-specific places (PRESET_RECIPES zone_stops, recorded per run); blends all red (zone 0). Water has no Unity convention yet, so a water mesh uses the bunker roles: rim grass lip, bank dirt, bed and deep water floor.

recipes.name: Keep OPCD shape (paint only)
recipes.author: golfmap
recipes.notes: No reshaping: OPCD's bunker as conformed, paint remapped to the golfmap roles. Pick a shaping recipe per bunker in the Terrain editor.

recipes.name: Conway bunker (standard)
recipes.author: cesimgolf
recipes.notes: Digs 0.3 m (concave lip), joins bunker + blend and builds ce.simgolf's stack of 1-3 cm terraces across the seam (loop cuts, spacing, lip steps, random slides, widened interior). Joined: rings 0-2 red, ring 3 black - the whole blend (outer edge red, the seam black). Separated bunker: filled green, rings 0-1 red, ring 2 black. ce.simgolf's paint: red = lip with 3D grass -> grassLip, black = the same lip without 3DG, darkened for a rolled-lip shadow -> shadow, green = sand -> floor, blue = wet floor -> floor. Blend: red = the rough -> adjoining, black at the seam -> browning; his blue ('grass browning into the lip dirt') -> browning. No dirt face: the lip is grass down to the sand.

recipes.name: Hazeltine bunker
recipes.author: cesimgolf
recipes.notes: Deep dig (2.5 m, dig shape 2) from the rim, then the same terrace stack as Conway with more spacing on the bunker side. Joined: rings 0-1 red, ring 2 blue (the blend seam). Separated bunker: filled green, rings 0-1 red, ring 2 black. Same ce.simgolf meanings as Conway; the blue on the blend seam is his 'grass browning into the lip' -> browning.

recipes.name: BLRK bunker simple (no dig)
recipes.author: BLRK
recipes.notes: No dig: three loop cuts across the seam, 4-5 mm lip steps. Joined: filled red (the whole blend red). Separated bunker: three more cuts at the rim, spacing and small lip steps, filled green then blue (all blue), green on 40-80 deg slopes, rings 0-6 green, green grown in 3x (35/25/15 %), ring 0 red, rings 1-2 black. BLRK's material (Bunker-for-blrk-bunker-simple.mat next to the recipe): red = a green-tinted grass texture -> grassLip, black = dirt (OPCD array index 4, darkened 0.72) -> dirt, green and blue = sand (index 6; green with a stronger blend for the face) -> floor. Blend all red -> adjoining.

recipes.name: KA deeper bunker with higher lip
recipes.file: kaustin-Deeper Bunker w higher lip-20260928T172402Z-1-001/Deeper Bunker w higher lip/KA_Bunker_higher_lip.json
recipes.author: kaustin
recipes.notes: Joins every blend into the bunker for good (no blend objects remain; Unity must drop their FBX), 1.5 m concave dig, random slides, widened interior, a raised outer lip (z shifts). Paint: filled red, ring 5 green (60 %), rings 5+ green, rings 7+ black, ring 7 flecked green. kaustin's ReadMe: black = his base material (the sand), red = set to the adjoining material, green = the dirt part of the lip. So red -> grassLip, green -> dirt, black -> floor. Screenshots: grass down to a thin dirt edge over the sand.

recipes.name: KA lake, gradual entry
recipes.author: kaustin
recipes.notes: Joins the blends in for good, pulls ring 1 out, one cut, two 3 m concave digs (insets 3, 4), then a gentle bank (z shifts +4..7 cm on rings 1-5). Paint: filled red, ring 4 black (60 %), rings 5+ black. kaustin: red = adjoining grass -> grassLip, black = the base material (the lake bed) -> floor. No dirt band: grass runs into the bed (his screenshots).

recipes.name: KA lake, overhang
recipes.author: kaustin
recipes.notes: Joins the blends in for good, two cuts at the rim, a 2 m concave dig, random slides and a widened interior (inner rings pushed out under the lip: an overhanging grass edge), smoothed floor. Paint: filled red, ring 4 black (20 %), rings 5+ black. red -> grassLip, black (kaustin's base material) -> floor.

recipes.name: Gradual edge lake
recipes.author: unknown
recipes.notes: Smooths the lake interior, digs 2 m with a convex lip, joins the blend, paints the joined ring 0 (the blend's outer edge) red, one cut in the blend, small lip steps, widens the interior. The water mesh keeps OPCD's paint (grass rim, soil, bed: opcdDefault). The blend ends up red all over (OPCD red at the water, the new red outside): the adjoining grass.

recipes.name: KA creek
recipes.author: kaustin
recipes.notes: kaustin's lake recipe style (KA_ prefix, permanent join, red fill, black base): pulls ring 1 out, one cut, two concave digs (1 m, then 1.5 m from ring 3), a raised bank (z shifts on rings 1-5), random slide, smoothed bed. Paint: filled red, rings 6+ black at 75 % (80 % of them), rings 7+ black. red -> grassLip, black -> floor (bed). Not the default: on Vreta's creeks (OPCD meshes 2-3 rings wide, joined 3-4) the bed paint never lands and the whole creek is grass (checked on others_f, others_9, others_11d), and the dig/cut fail on the narrowest ones (hole_18_10: loopcut finds no inner vertex; bunkeredit divides by zero below 4 rings). Fine for wide creeks.

recipes.name: Creek, narrow (golfmap, from KA creek)
recipes.author: golfmap
recipes.notes: Ours (blender/recipes/), after kaustin's KA_Creek for Vreta's narrow creeks (OPCD meshes 2-3 rings wide): KA's loop cut and bunkeredit digs fail on them (no inner vertex / division by zero below 4 rings) and its bed paint (rings 6+) never lands. Joins the blends in for good, pulls ring 1 out 7 cm like KA, steps rings 1+ down 3 cm, 2+ 12 cm, 3+ 8 cm, 4+ 5 cm (bunkereditlip works on any width), KA's random slide and interior smoothing (wide creeks only). Paint in golfmap colours (identity map): filled red (the former blend = grass lip), rings 1+ dirt with half of ring 1 flecked back to grass at 50 %, rings 2+ floor (bed). Ran on all 13 Vreta creeks without an error (max 0.23 m down).

recipes.name: Bunker Studio dig + Conway lip (golfmap)
recipes.author: golfmap
recipes.notes: Ours (blender/recipes/, golfmap-recipe-v1): Bunker Studio's Classic dig in metres (depth, face widths, high crown toward the hole's green: the rim point facing the green of the bunker's hole), then ce.simgolf's Conway lip stack without its bunkeredit dig, counted from the seam of Bunker Studio's four-row blend. Paint: Bunker Studio's dirt -> sand mask (golfmap dirt / floor) and blend fade (browning at the bunker, adjoining outside, 3D-grass density in the blend's UV0), then Conway's grass lip (rings 0-1) and shadow (ring 2) on the separated bunker's rim (ce.simgolf colours, translated step by step: red grassLip, black shadow). faceSteepness divides the preset's face widths; highSideStrength scales its high crown raise and high-face tightening.

recipes.name: Shoreline creek, Meadow Brook (golfmap)
recipes.author: golfmap
recipes.notes: Ours (golfmap-recipe-v1): Shoreline Studio's Meadow Brook (broad U-shaped channel, soft banks, gentle meander; seeded from the parent id and the recipe seed; the fall along the creek kept) then golfmap-creek-narrow's bank paint (identity map): the blends joined in for good as the grass lip, rings 1+ dirt, rings 2+ bed. Needs one water base with its blends (OPCD's split creek pieces without a blend of their own are refused by Shoreline and left as they were).

recipes.name: Shoreline creek, Maintained Drain (golfmap)
recipes.author: golfmap
recipes.notes: As golfmap-creek-shoreline-meadow-brook with Shoreline's Maintained Drain: a controlled trapezoidal channel with consistent fall (no meander, no pools).

recipes.name: Shoreline lake, Natural Pond + overhang (golfmap)
recipes.author: golfmap
recipes.notes: Ours (golfmap-recipe-v1): Shoreline Studio's Natural Pond (lobed edge, uneven shelf, off-centre basin), then kaustin's Lake Overhang edge steps without his dig: blends joined in for good, two loop cuts at the rim, random slides, the interior widened under the lip (the overhanging grass edge), smoothed floor. Paint: Shoreline's zones (studioPaint: rim grass lip, bank dirt, bed floor); kaustin's paint steps are left out.

recipes.name: KA creek, deep
recipes.author: kaustin
recipes.notes: KA_Creek with a 3.5 m second dig. Same paint and mapping.

recipes.name: Simple creek (double subdivided)
recipes.author: unknown
recipes.notes: Reshape only: 0.4 m and 0.1 m lip steps on the creek, joins the blend, 2-7 cm steps on rings 1-4, separates. No paint: OPCD's paint stays and opcdDefault maps it. Meant for a mesh subdivided twice beforehand (name).

recipes.name: Raised path (blitz)
recipes.author: unknown
recipes.notes: Joins the path's blends in for good, two cuts at the edge, raises the edge rings 5-20 mm (negative lip depth) for a curbed, raised path. Paint: filled red, ring 0 black. Paths have no golfmap roles (the convention is bunkers and water): paint kept as is - red = the path surface, black = its outer edge fading to the neighbour in the path material. Not run on Vreta yet.

recipes.name: Rustic path (no subdivide)
recipes.author: unknown
recipes.notes: Joins the blends in for good, fills red, jitters ring 2, paints rings 2+ black, then inverts the selection and separates it as a 'Rough' mesh (a new object the engine does not pair). Paint kept as is (no path roles). Not run on Vreta yet.

recipes.name: Basic loop paint
recipes.author: unknown
recipes.notes: Paint utility, no shaping: the mesh's boundary ring blue (except vertices spaced > 0.75 m, i.e. edges shared with the same material), grown one ring. Not offered for a surface; on a bunker it would be sand at the rim, which opcdDefault already reads as floor.

recipes.name: Three colour blend
recipes.author: unknown
recipes.notes: Blend utility: swaps red and black (OPCD's red at the hazard / black outside becomes black at the hazard, red outside - the golfmap blend layout), cuts a middle ring, turns blue into green. Needs the blend selected on its own; the engine runs recipes on the feature's mesh, so it is not offered for a surface.
